metric: Both PrivateMemorySize64 and conservative WorkingSet64 bytes must meet the limit; CPU normalized to one logical core
build_requirement: Release; record CMake cache, Qt/compiler, DPI/GPU/backend separately in report
scope: P1 isolated GUI replay process; no Mihomo/helper/update process exists in this prototype
exclusions: Collector process and screenshot/profiler tools; future necessary client processes must be aggregated
limitations: Sampled peaks can miss sub-interval spikes; no GPU/private-working-set attribution, scrolling, frame times or real business workload. Defaults are quick exploration; formal runs need >=120s warmup, >=5 repeats and design scenario durations.
